title: "S2 - Zero-flow audit"
output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/00_utils/notebook_setup.R")
```

**Stage:** S2 (zero-flow audit).
**Purpose:** classify every zero-flow day so that "zero" is never silently
read as "no water". A zero is labelled `positive`, `real-zero`, `artifact`,
`unknown` or `missing`, using same-basin peer gauges as an independent proxy.
**Inputs:** `output/zero_audit_summary.csv` (stage S2),
`output/inventory.csv`.
**Outputs:** none (assertion + documentation notebook).
**Parameters:** `P$zero_unresolved_max`, `P$seed`.

## Load and check schema

```{r}
aud <- nb_require("zero_audit_summary.csv", "S2")
nb_assert_cols(aud,
  c("gauge_id", "basin", "n_days", "n_positive", "n_real_zero",
    "n_artifact", "n_unknown", "n_missing", "match_grade"),
  "zero audit")
nb_assert(all(aud$match_grade == "proxy"),
          "this build uses the basin-peer proxy grade only")

counts <- aud[, .(n_days = sum(n_days), positive = sum(n_positive),
                  real_zero = sum(n_real_zero), artifact = sum(n_artifact),
                  unknown = sum(n_unknown), missing = sum(n_missing))]
knitr::kable(counts, caption = "Zero classes pooled over audited gauges")
```

## Where the zeros are

```{r}
aud[, `:=`(frac_artifact = n_artifact / pmax(n_days, 1),
           frac_unknown = n_unknown / pmax(n_days, 1))]
knitr::kable(
  aud[order(-frac_artifact)][1:10,
      .(gauge_id, basin, n_days, n_artifact, n_unknown, n_missing,
        frac_artifact = round(frac_artifact, 3),
        frac_unknown = round(frac_unknown, 3))],
  caption = "Gauges with the largest artifact-zero fractions")
```

## Treatment variants and the unresolved-zero rule

`[assumption]` Because no independent CWC / India-WRIS daily record was
available for these stations, the classifier uses same-basin peers and is
marked `match_grade = "proxy"` (plan section 3.9 fallback). Three treatment
variants are carried through every sensitivity run:

- **V0 as-recorded** -- zeros are true zero supply (the v1 behaviour; kept
  only to quantify the artifact's effect).
- **V1 zeros-as-missing** -- artifact and unknown zeros become missing days;
  the queue pauses on short gaps and excludes the month on long gaps.
- **V2 verified-flow-only** -- keep positive and real-zero days, then drop every
  day of a calendar month whose verified fraction is below 90%.

```{r}
nb_assert(all(aud$n_artifact >= 0) && all(aud$n_unknown >= 0),
          "negative class count")
n_high_unknown <- sum(aud$frac_unknown > P$zero_unresolved_max)
cat(sprintf("gauges with > %.0f%% unknown zeros: %d (excluded unless V2 covers them)\n",
            100 * P$zero_unresolved_max, n_high_unknown))
```

The primary analysis uses **V1**. V0 and V2 are reported as predeclared
sensitivities; no variant is chosen after seeing an endpoint result.
